description: Get the file-level diff for a merge request (hunks + per-line annotations).

all.description: Fetch all pages. Defaults to true when page is omitted.

expand.description: Expand collapsed text diffs; defaults to true.

fields.description: Return only these top-level fields (plus id keys), narrowing the response further.

page.description: Zero-based page index; selects one page unless all is true.

raw.description: Return the full, un-slimmed GitFlic response for THIS call (no token compression). Use when the default slim view dropped a field you need.

size.description: Requested page size; server limits are respected.

name: gitflic_mr_diff
